privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: Sidera works out charts without keeping them. This page says exactly what happens to the details you give.

glance.title: No sign up
glance.text: You never sign up or sign in. Saving a report only gives this browser a private key.

glance.title: Nothing kept by default
glance.text: A chart or a match is worked out and sent back. Nothing about it is saved unless you press Save.

glance.title: Saving and sharing are your choice
glance.text: Only Save and share links keep a copy, and you can delete either at any time.

glance.title: No birth details in logs
glance.text: Logs hold only the page, the result code and the time taken.

sections.title: What you give
body: The date, time and place of birth (or a latitude, longitude and time zone), and a name if you want one. For a match, the same for two people, or only their birth stars.
These are sent in the body of the request, never in the page address, and are used only to work out the result.

sections.title: What is kept
body: Nothing, unless you press Save on a result or Create link in the Share dialog.

Then a copy of that result is kept, in Sinhala and English, with the birth date, time and place line, and the name or names unless you chose to hide them. The link code and its delete code are kept only in a scrambled (hashed) form.
A share link closes after 30 days and is then deleted. The device that made it can delete it sooner.

When you press Save, a copy of that result is kept for My reports, in Sinhala and English, with the details it was made from (name, birth date, time and place), so you can open it, download it and share it again. It belongs to a guest account that holds nothing else about you: no email, no name of yours and no password.
A guest account that is not used for a year is deleted with its reports. You can delete one report, or all of them, from My reports at any time.

sections.title: On your device
body: Your last result is kept in this browser tab, so a reload does not lose it. It is cleared when the tab closes.
If you tick Remember my chart on this device, that chart is kept in this browser until you press Forget. It is never kept on our servers.
When you make a share link, its delete code is kept in this browser so you can delete the link later.

When you first press Save, the site sets two cookies: a private key that tells our server which reports are yours (your browser keeps it hidden from the page), and a small marker that shows the My reports link. Without Save there are no cookies.
There are no adverts and no tracking or analytics.

sections.title: Logs
body: The servers record each request's method, page path, result code and time taken. Share codes are hidden in the path. Logs never hold names, birth details or anything you typed.

sections.title: PDF reports
body: A PDF is made on the server when you ask for it and sent straight to you. It is not kept.

sections.title: Who runs the site
body: The pages are served by Vercel. The calculations, share links and saved reports run on Render, in Singapore. Fonts and pictures come from the site itself, so your browser does not contact other services.

sections.title: Questions and deletion
body: To delete a share link, open it on the device that made it and press Delete this link.
To delete a saved report, or all of them, open My reports in the same browser.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.lead: Please read these short terms before using the site.

sections.title: What the site is
body: A tool that works out a Sri Lankan birth chart (hadahan) and a marriage match (porondam) from astronomical calculations and traditional rules, in Sinhala and English.

sections.title: For guidance only
body: The results are for guidance and cultural interest. They do not predict events, health or outcomes, and the site never tells anyone whether to marry.
For important decisions, speak with your family and a practising astrologer.

sections.title: Rules can differ
body: Traditions differ, and some rules here are provisional until a practising astrologer confirms them. The pages mark these.

sections.title: Accuracy
body: A result is only as good as the birth time and place given. A few minutes' difference can change the lagna, and the page warns when that is likely.

sections.title: Sharing
body: You choose what to share. Please do not share another person's birth details without their agreement.

sections.title: Fair use
body: Please do not try to break, overload or copy the site in bulk.

sections.title: Changes
body: These terms may change. The date at the top shows the latest version.

kendara.title: Find the birth from an old horoscope
kendara.lead: Copy the kendara from the paper: the lagna sign, then each planet's box. We search every birth from 1900 to now that fits it.

form.tapBox: Now tap the box where {planet} is drawn.
form.allPlaced: All nine planets are placed. To move one, tap it above, then tap its new box.
form.navamshaHint: Many old horoscopes have it. It narrows the time to about a quarter of an hour.
form.factsLead: All optional. Each one narrows the search.
form.placeHint: It sets the lagna. Colombo if left empty.
form.privacy: Nothing is stored. The drawing is used once for the search.

errors.navamshaLagna: Please choose the navamsha lagna sign, or remove the navamsha kendara.
errors.failed: The search could not be done. Please try again.

results.title: {count} possible births
results.provisional: The search is provisional until an astrologer confirms it. A birth near the edge of a window may fall just outside it.
results.middle: The forms use the middle of this window, {time}. The hadahan's birth time check shows what may change inside it.
results.sharedStar: Every match has the birth star {star}, pada {pada}. That is enough for a birth star porondam match.
results.starAsBride: Match this star as the bride
results.starAsGroom: Match this star as the groom
